answer_1.quote: We focus on the task of decomposing English complex questions for machine reading comprehension (MRC), into a sequence of subquestions ...

answer_2.quote: we evaluate on the development sets ... using automatic metrics that compare between the Qs against the reference decompositions ... (i) exact match (EM), (ii) SARI, and (iii) graph edit distance (GED).

answer_3.quote: we use a panel of CLLMs (that we denote as CLLM rank each) for ranking all of the candidate decompositions ... we prompt each CLLM rank to rank the quality of the candidate decomposition.
